title: Digestion, Molecules, and Cell Fuel Review Test
description: Spaced review for trace how digestive, circulatory, and cellular processes turn food into usable materials and energy access for cells.

questions.prompt: What does digestion do to large food molecules?
questions.questionText: What does digestion do to large food molecules?
options: breaks them into smaller molecules cells can use

options: the cracker becomes a living cell

questions.correctAnswer: starch begins breaking into smaller sugar molecules

questions.prompt: A student says the stomach gives energy directly to muscles. What is best?

questions.correctAnswer: Food molecules are broken down and transported before cells release usable energy.
questions.explanation: Cells release usable energy from molecules.
